title: dedicated-fleet-autoscaler: burst controls, priority routing, and utilization reporting enhancements
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Context: customers running Dedicated capacity observed transient queueing spikes during sudden demand bursts and uneven utilization across priority classes. This PR implements a combination of burst-token controls, priority-aware request routing, and enhanced utilization reporting to improve tail latency and provide operators better visibility. Changes include: 1) tokenbucket-based burst limiter per fleet with configurable smoothing windows and per-priority ceilings; 2) priority-aware routing rules that prefer low-latency pools for high-priority routes while allowing best-effort requests to spill to lower-cost pools; 3) telemetry: new Prometheus metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens, dedicated_autoscaler_smoothing_rate, fleet_priority_utilization) and a per-fleet utilization dashboard in Redwood Console; 4) safety: automatic fallback policy when token pools are exhausted to avoid head-of-line blocking; 5) migration: on-start migration job to initialize token buckets for existing fleets. Motivation: reduce 99th percentile latency during short bursts while protecting throughput guarantees and giving SREs actionable utilization signals. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4321) [x] unit & integration tests [x] e2e canary on staging [x] docs + console dashboard entry [x] feature flagged rollout. How to test: run autoscaler unit/integration test suites, deploy to staging with feature flag enabled, replay recorded burst workload (scripts/bench/replay_burst.py), verify token consumption metrics and that high-priority routes maintain latency SLO. Rollout plan: gated by feature flag; enable for 10% of fleets behind canary UI; monitor dedicated_autoscaler_burst_tokens and fleet_priority_utilization for regressions before full ramp.
commits: Init tokenbucket-based burst limiter and smoothing logic; add config knobs for per-priority ceilings
Implement priority-aware routing and fallbacks; update routing policy engine to accept priority weights
Add Prometheus metrics and Console dashboard scaffolding; wire metrics through telemetry pipeline
Migration job to seed token buckets for existing fleets; add idempotent initialization logic
Add unit/integration tests, e2e replay script, and docs updates
